note: Small wooded access on the Elk Fork of the Salt River southwest of Paris, with no boat ramp. MDC maps no campsites here; the only developed spot is a small gravel pull-off lot on the west side of County Road 857, just north of its one-lane truss bridge over the river, about 40 m back from the water through trees. Spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed MDC 'Designated Camping Sites' (plus walk/float/backpack open camping, no deer/turkey season) - free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit. No camping point in the GIS and none on the 06/11 map, so the sites are unmapped. The one lot (GIS 135 = stored pin) is a ~15 x 25 m gravel pull-off on CR 857, reached from Hwy 24 without crossing the bridge. Kept on the MDC tag with the caveat. Pin fine; not waterfront kept; phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT (sites unmapped): the area page lists 'Camping: Open Camping-Walk/Float/Backpack(no Deer/Turkey); Designated Camping Sites', and says 'This area provides access to the Elk Fork Salt River but there is no boat ramp.' MDC GIS layer 27 has no camping point for area 8028. The 06/11 area map shows only a single Parking Lot symbol on the east boundary at CR 857 and no Primitive Camping Area symbol. So there's no designated site to find. The lot (GIS 135, 39.43647,-92.05051 = the stored pin) is a small gravel widening on the west side of the gravel county road, ~15 x 25 m on the 0.14 m/px leaf-off frame, which is enough to park a 23-ft rig. It's reached from Hwy 24 south 2.5 miles on CR 857, so there's no need to cross the one-lane steel truss bridge just south. Keep on the MDC tag with the caveat (note says MDC maps no campsites). If AWH requires a mapped designated site, this is a drop candidate.
PIN: stored = GIS parking lot 135, on the gravel pull-off - fine.
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): the lot is ~40 m from the river's edge through a wooded bank; there's no opening from the lot.
PHONE: (573) 248-2530 on the area page matches.
